title: Nonexistence of single-bubble solutions for a slightly supercritical Choquard equation
summary: In this paper, we consider the existence of positive solutions to the following slightly supercritical Choquard equation \begin{equation*} \begin{cases} -Δu=\displaystyle\Big(\int\limits_Ω\frac{u^{2^*_α+\varepsilon}(y)}{|x-y|^α}dy\Big)u^{2^*_α-1+\varepsilon},\quad u>0\ \ &\mbox{in}\ Ω, \quad \ \ u=0 \ \ &\mbox{on}\ \partial Ω, \end{cases} \end{equation*} where $N\geq 3$, $Ω$ is a smooth bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^{N}$, $α\in (0,N)$, $2^*_α:=\frac{2N-α}{N-2}$ is the upper critical exponent in the sense of Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev inequality and $\varepsilon>0$ is a small parameter.
